sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Repair the semantic coverage boundary before freezing. The candidate only links associated equipment and checks hazard/evidence on each machinery installation; it does not establish protection coverage for every associated equipment item, nor pair each applicable hazard with corresponding evidence. Add or locate the canonical cross-owner relationship/path required to connect each associated equipment item and applicable hazard to its protection evidence, preserving the authoritative owners and without relocating properties to the ship or benchmarkEntity. Replace the installation-level presence-only SPARQL check with portable SHACL Core plus bounded SPARQL that validates per-hazard, per-associated-equipment coverage and cannot pass from one unpaired evidence artifact. Preserve conditional applicability and do not require all six hazards universally or the ship-level summary boolean.
